scope: Independent model review of 24 boss key-art pieces and 12 dungeon cinematics. Every final source image was directly viewed in the cited individual/batch reviews. Coverage aggregation did not reinspect unchanged files.
selectionRule: Final metadata precedence: redesigned, then repaired, then generated. Exact current SHA-256 verified against existing hashes where present; earlier benchmark and batch hashes calculated now.

evidence: Blunt crushing ridges and shortened shovel skull materially distinguish the mouth from the previous ordinary crocodile design.
The slab-breaking action is more central and readable.
Three near-side load-bearing limbs remain separately readable with convincing ground contact.
limits: The masonry slab occludes portions of the lower grinder, so this is not a complete anatomical reference for its paired articulation.
All six limb attachments remain partly occluded by the intended three-quarter view.

limits: Shield forearm reads as a compact forged gauntlet rather than a broad shield; enough functional identity survives for the still.

evidence: Mirror chest and shutter-plate arms establish a distinct military construct function.

limits: One lower arm is partly occluded; exact full joint topology and physically correct solar concentration are not verified by the still.

Solar fortress, broken mirrors and ammunition lifts provide strong regional continuity.

evidence: Empty cloth head remains a physical folded form rather than a generic smoke face.

evidence: Both feet sets share a visible landing, removing the building-sized giant impression.

The lifted weight and breaking causeway clearly link action and consequence.
Tiny ward team, still black water and restrained red fissure make threat legible without a demon face.

evidence: Half-drawn actual blade and longer reflected blade convey the single uncanny cue.

evidence: Walkable ceramic burial bells are a specific spatial invention rather than a generic cathedral hall.

evidence: Broken solar mirrors, ammunition lifts and high military ramps establish the bastion function.

evidence: Arbitrary wall inscription is removed and weathered stone restored.

evidence: Open circular court and severe quartz fins establish the trial arena while preserving room to move.
Distant mountain landmark and local damaged access create two destination scales.
Ivory, graphite and controlled warm seams match the Glass Sovereign setting.
limits: Detail-rich stairs and statues are less severe than the original minimal-court brief, but the central arena retains visual rest.

evidence: Right-wall generated slogan is removed; statue and rock surface remain convincing.
Wayfinding pictograms replace copy without hiding routes.
Suspended hull, storm-driven water and lit work platforms retain narrative purpose.
Crescent observatory instruments, salt architecture and exposed lens well make a coherent desert identity.
Sand crossing the causeways indicates active environmental change.
Eclipse, distant platform and foreground route branches give strong depth.
Severed causeways, black water and reflected starfield communicate frontier isolation and navigational risk.
Red environmental fissure remains distant; no prison interior or explicit cosmological entity is depicted.
Root growth and failed crossing provide material history and immediate route choices.

conclusion: All 36 final selected source images have explicit model-review acceptance for finished gallery publication. Prior rejected/held versions are superseded only by the exact paths listed here.
limitations: This is model judgment, not human art-director approval, IP clearance, or proof of studio-equivalent production quality.
Perspective stills do not certify exact scale, hidden anatomy, physics, animation rigs or playable encounters.
Some environment arrivals repeat a shared compositional grammar; redesigned d04/d06 improve variety.
Generation provenance receives 4/5 pending broader release-manifest verification; no visible final watermarks or accidental text remain in inspected final versions.
